s.note: the murder capital of the world
s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries, soak for 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until golden. Toss with fine salt, garlic powder and chopped parsley and serve in paper cones.

Mash 100g soft butter with 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread generously, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil and bake 3 minutes more to crisp.

m.note: the noodles that look a lot like worms
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a smoking wok, then add a quarter cabbage, 200g bean sprouts and 400g fresh egg noodles. Toss with 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy and sesame oil. Fry 300g cooked jasmine rice with egg and spring onion alongside.

w.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb. Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.

d.n: Holy water cucumber and lime fizz
d.note: the squirt guns full of holy water
d.how: Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint and 60ml sugar syrup in a jug. Strain into 4 small glass bottles or tall glasses filled with ice. Top each with 150ml chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Draw a little cross on paper tags and tie them round the necks.
